run_whisper_asr_inference: run whisper ASR inference on wav files with language IDs and output hypotheses and scores
run_asr_with_language_mapping: run whisper ASR decoding using a language code mapping file to translate MMS codes to Whisper codes
run_asr_with_beam_search: run whisper ASR inference with configurable beam size for n-best decoding on audio files
run_asr_with_repetition: run whisper ASR inference repeating each wav file n times to generate multiple hypotheses per audio
run_asr_score_calculation: run whisper ASR inference and compute scores from average log probability multiplied by token length
